inline_comments.comment: The bump type `major` is far too high for adding a documentation entry to the community integrations list. A `major` semver bump signals a breaking change to library consumers. Per the contribution guidelines, new feature additions should be `minor`; a docs-only community-list addition is arguable as `patch`. This should be changed to `patch` (or at most `minor`).

This file is an exact duplicate of `.changeset/full-clubs-learn.md` (same bump type, same description). It should be deleted. Having two identical changesets for the same package and the same change will produce a duplicate entry in the `CHANGELOG.md` and double-counts the version bump.

This file appears to have been manually created (it is named after the issue number `7123`, rather than following the project's auto-generated `adjective-noun-verb.md` naming convention). It also conflicts with the other two changeset files by declaring `patch` while the others declare `major`. Since all three cover the same single change, only one changeset file should exist; please delete the duplicates and keep only the auto-generated file with the corrected bump type.
Typo: `marmaid.js` should be `mermaid.js`. The same typo also appears in the PR title and description.

The `[News]` sub-item links to a raw `NEWS` changelog file in the GitHub repository. No other entry in this integrations list links to a project's changelog or news file — typical sub-items are functional links (docs, source, marketplace, package index). This link adds noise rather than helping users discover or use the integration, and should be removed.
Same as the source file: the `[News]` link to a raw `NEWS` changelog file has no precedent elsewhere in the list and should be removed.

general_comments.comment: Three changeset files are included for a single change to a single package (`mermaid`): `.changeset/7123.md` (patch), `.changeset/full-clubs-learn.md` (major), and `.changeset/true-parrots-build.md` (major, identical to `full-clubs-learn.md`). Per the project rule, each `.changeset/*.md` file should cover changes for exactly one package; having three files for one package and one PR will produce duplicate and conflicting changelog entries and a runaway version bump. Delete two of the three files, correct the bump type on the remaining one to `patch`, and fix the `marmaid.js` typo in the description.
The typo `marmaid.js` (instead of `mermaid.js`) appears in the PR title, the PR description, and all three changeset message bodies. Please fix it in all locations before merging.
